:::{#hero-heading}

I am a postdoctoral researcher at [INRAE](https://www.inrae.fr/en),
based in the [DECOD lab](https://www.umr-decod.fr/en) in Rennes, France.

My work combines data analysis, statistics, and theoretical modeling to address
fundamental questions in ecology. In particular, I have sustaine interest in
network ecology, species and community stability, and the development of
open-source tools in R and Julia.

You can have a look at my [research projects](project.html) and my
[publications](publications.html). You can also retrieve my work on [google
scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=ebpnCOUAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=ao)
and have a look at my [resume](resume.html).

Feel free to reach at [ismael.lajaaiti[at]inrae.fr](mailto:ismael.lajaaiti@inrae.fr).

:::
